associations.rationale: The type constructs a basis indexed by finite subsets, but it does not itself expose the basis elements as ordered Clifford monomials or state the spanning and dimension clauses of the complete claim.
The theorem states the finrank formula 2^N, but it does not itself state the ordered-monomial basis or spanning clauses, so it covers only the dimension component.
The theorem states that the range of the opaque family e spans the Clifford algebra, but it does not itself identify ordered Clifford monomials as a basis or state the dimension formula.
